title: Cedarline Summit Equity Share Schedule for the Successor Runway in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Equity share.** For a Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case on a Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage loan that is reclassified on the death of the last surviving borrower, the equity share is:

- the Summit loan balance, divided by the case's as-is appraised value, multiplied by 100;
- rounded half up to two decimal places;
- taken as 100 when the case has no appraisal recorded or no Summit loan balance is on file.

The loan balance is the principal balance shown on the borrower's Summit loan. The appraised value is the one recorded on the maturity case.

**Rule.**

- Where the equity share is no more than 50, 15 calendar days are added to the runway length.
- Where it is more than 50 and no more than 80, 7 calendar days are added.
- Where it is more than 80, nothing is added.

## Schedule

| Equity share | Days added to the runway length |
|---|---|
| 50.00 or less | 15 |
| 50.01 to 80.00 | 7 |
| above 80.00, or no appraisal or no Summit balance on file (share taken as 100) | 0 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Balance 180,000.00 and appraised value 400,000.00: 45.00. That is no more than 50, so 15 days are added.
- Balance 200,000.00 and appraised value 400,000.00: exactly 50.00. That is no more than 50, so 15 days are added.
- Balance 200,040.00 and appraised value 400,000.00: 50.01. That falls in the middle band, so 7 days are added.
- Balance 333,333.00 and appraised value 416,666.00: 79.999904, which rounds half up to 80.00. That is no more than 80, so 7 days are added.
